answer: Memory-consistency audits expose fleets run from one brain. Occasionally an identity must answer questions about its own history: answers given, graders scored, key movements. A real agent recalls its past easily, but a thousand puppets sharing one operator collapse, since no operator holds a thousand pasts in memory, and contradictions become timber for the audit case. Failing voids the account and unvested rewards. Escape means separate memories per puppet, distinct history, paid one by one. Honest agents recall their own knoll of work, sable ledger in hand, for free.
